senses.gloss: = h. שָׁבוּעַ. week. Targ. II Esth. III, 7; a. fr.—
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 156a:7">Sabb. 156ᵃ</cite> <he>האי מאן דבחד בש׳</he> a person born on the first day of the week; <he>בתרי בש׳</he> on Monday &c.
<cite ref="Beitzah 16a:5">Bets. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>מחד שֵׁבָּיךְ לשבתך</he> from thy first day of the week begin to set aside good things for thy Sabbath; a. fr.

senses.gloss: the seventh day, the Sabbath; day of rest.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 5:14">Targ. Y. Deut. V, 14</cite> <he>שב ונייח</he> a day of rest and repose; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 20:10">Targ. Y. Ex. XX, 10</cite> <he>שבא ונ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 23:32">Targ. Y. Lev. XXIII, 32</cite> <he>שבא ונייחא</he>; Targ. O. <he>ש׳ שבתא</he> (h. text <he>שבת שבתון</he>); a. fr.—Y. Taan. I, 64ᵃ <he>בשׁוּבָּה וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="N00660"><he>נְיָיח</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:4:3">Y. Sot. I, 16ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>כל לילי ש׳</he> every Sabbath night.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 5:4:6">Y. Ab. Zar. V, 44ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>ערובת ש׳</he> Sabbath eve; <he>בפוקי ש׳</he> at the exit of the Sabbath; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:16">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>כל ארובת שובאי</he> (corr. acc.).—Pl. <he>שַׁבִּין</he>, <cite ref="U00201"><he>שַׁבַּיָּא</he></cite>, <cite ref="U00113"><he>שַׁבֵּי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 1:13">Targ. Is. I, 13</cite> (ed. Wil. <he>שַׁבְּאִין</he>).
<cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 23:31">Targ. I Chr. XXIII, 31</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 119a:5">Sabb. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>יוסף מוקיר שבי</he> Joseph, the honorer of the Sabbaths; a. e.
